<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template for a Friedel‑Crafts acylation. The forward reaction forms a ketone (so the retrosynthetic step breaks a ketone) and breaks an aryl halide bond. Using the available functional groups, we search for templates that break an “aryl halide” (or generic “halide”) and form a “ketone”, with the appropriate bond changes (break C‑Cl, form C‑C). This should return a template ID we can then apply to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CNc1c(C(=O)Nc2cccc(OC)c2)nnn1Cc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
